verdict.rationale: The Apple M4 Pro is a system-on-chip, so in-product AI insights and suggestions drawn from a user's data are a software or SaaS feature and a category error for a processor. The evidence only shows the chip accelerating on-device Apple Intelligence models, local LLMs and ML frameworks. Those are host-OS features or developer building blocks, not an insights capability shipped by the chip itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
